map.为什么均值会高于中位数？: Why Can the Mean Be Higher Than the Median?
map.取决于指标性质：营收、现金流这类越大越好的指标波动大意味着可预测性差；试错型投入: It depends on the nature of the metric: for metrics where bigger is better, such as revenue and cash flow, a large fluctuation means poor predictability, while the fluctuation of experimental investments may come from deliberate diversification and should be read against the business goal.
map.对标同行公开数据时，用同一口径的均值与标准差做横向比较，避免只看峰值造成定位偏差: When benchmarking against public industry data, compare horizontally with the mean and standard deviation on the same definition, so a positioning error from looking only at the peak is avoided.
map.战略研讨会前汇总各业务线关键指标（客单价、复购率），用离散程度看哪条线最难预测。: Before the strategy workshop, summarise the key metrics of each business line (average ticket, repeat purchase rate) and use the dispersion to see which line is hardest to forecast.
map.把近 12 个月营收按月贴入，看均值、中位数与极差，判断增长是稳步抬升还是靠单月: Paste in the revenue for the last 12 months by month, look at the mean, median, and range, and judge whether growth is a steady rise or relies on a single strong month.
map.标准差大一定是坏事吗？: Is a Large Standard Deviation Always Bad?
map.说明分布右偏，即存在少数远高于多数的值；此时中位数更贴近典型水平，均值更适合做总: It indicates a right-skewed distribution, that is, a few values far above the majority; here the median is closer to the typical level while the mean suits aggregate estimation, so look at both.
map.输入关键经营数据，按「分析—定位—实施」三段框架输出战略梳理结果与行动要点，辅助: Enter the key operating data and output the strategic review and action points following the three-stage "analyse, locate, implement" framework, supporting consultants and management in strategy workshops, project approval, and reporting.
map.输入营收还是利润都可以吗？: Can I Enter Either Revenue or Profit?
map.页面只做数值统计、不区分科目，需要你自行保证同一批数据同口径同单位；混贴不同科目: The page only does numerical statistics and does not distinguish accounts, so you must ensure the same definition and unit for a given batch of data; mixing accounts or units (ten thousand CNY and CNY) makes the mean and standard deviation meaningless.
map.：A 线标准差 32、B 线标准差 118，量级相近但 B 线波动接近 A 线的: : Line A has a standard deviation of 32 and line B 118; the magnitudes are comparable but line B fluctuates nearly 4 times as much. If the strategic goal is stable cash flow, shrink line B's fixed investment and switch to a variable cost structure first.
map.：贴入 12 个月营收得到均值 820 万、中位数 795 万、标准差 96 万: : Pasting in 12 months of revenue gives a mean of 8.2 million, a median of 7.95 million, and a standard deviation of 960,000. The mean above the median means a few months are high, so growth is driven by occasional large deals rather than being the norm; the baseline for resource allocation should follow the median, not the mean.
